title: trace model-reviewer parsed output
description: Parsed structured form of the model-Reviewer's `review.md`. The Reviewer is the adversarial counterpart to the Patcher; it reads the same bundle inputs the Patcher had PLUS the Patcher's `patch.diff` + `patch-rationale.md`, then issues a verdict + findings. This schema describes what the parser extracts; the canonical artifact on disk is `review.md` (per bundle-schema.json), with a strict heading contract enforced by `agents/reviewer/parser.py`. Distinct from `review-rubric-schema.json`, which describes human panelist reviews under `eval/reviews/*.json`.

verdict.description: The Reviewer's accept/reject/escalate decision. `accept` = bundle is mergeable as-is. `reject` = bundle MUST NOT merge; the reasoning + findings explain why. `escalate` = beyond the Reviewer's competence or the contract's coverage; needs human review even if Steward would otherwise auto-merge. The verdict is the load-bearing field; everything else justifies it.

reasoning.description: Free-form rationale supporting the verdict. The Reviewer should cite specific bundle artifacts (finding.json fields, upstream-ref.json fields, patch.diff hunks) rather than gesture at concepts. Two-to-six sentences in v1.

findings.description: Structured list of issues the Reviewer raised. An empty array MUST be paired with verdict=accept; non-empty paired with reject or escalate (not enforced by schema; enforced by reviewer prompt + scorer). Each finding has a severity, a short title, and a citation pointing at where the issue lives.

title.description: One-line summary of the issue. Imperative or declarative, no markdown markup.

citation.description: Pointer at the artifact + locus where the issue is observable. Format: `<artifact>:<key=value | line=N | hunk=N>`. Examples: `patch.diff:hunk=1`, `upstream-ref.json:target_version=3.6.8`, `patch-rationale.md:## Why minimal`.

detail.description: Optional extended explanation. Truncated at 2 KiB when serialised.

cited_evidence.description: List of bundle artifacts the Reviewer actually consulted. Used by the evidence-cited scorer to detect Reviewers that issue verdicts without engaging the inputs (`accept` with no citations is a structural fail). Format: `<artifact>` or `<artifact>:<sub-locator>`.

cross_family_attestation.description: Reviewer's declared model family + attestation that the family differs from the Patcher's. Required because the SPEC §4 cross-family rule forbids same-family Patcher/Reviewer pairs. The actual enforcement happens at replay time via `replay-schema.json`'s `cross_family_rule_honored` boolean; this string is the Reviewer's first-person statement of what family it belongs to and what family it understands the Patcher to be.

patch_comparison.description: Optional free-text section present only for source-backport reviews (reviewer.v5+). The `## Patch comparison` heading, in which the Reviewer walks each patch.diff hunk against the corresponding upstream-fix.patch hunk and states a per-hunk match/mismatch verdict. Absent for version-bump and non-source-backport reviews; its presence is graded by the advisory review-patch-comparison-present scorer, not required by this schema.
